_readme: Promote-time constraints that must bite ON THE DAY SOMEBODY PROMOTES, not in prose.
Checked by tools/agent/promote_atoms.py (selfcheck leg 'promote-atoms'); exit 3 on violation.
rule 'no_promote_without': if any `subject` id is PROMOTED (no live gate site left) while any
`prereq` id is still GATED, the tree ships a configuration no wave has run -> RED.
An id named here that is neither gated nor marked promoted anywhere in the tree is also RED:
a typo in this file must never make a constraint quietly vacuous.
ADD A ROW the moment a constraint is ruled, not when it is about to be violated.

atoms.direction: one-way: promoting fieldsip while the holding side stays gated is NOT constrained by this row.
note: ACCEPTED, with the premise re-founded on a bare reading rather than on the proposing
section's sentence. §ED.5 wrote '至今每一波给 stayfield/stayfield2 买 (a) 的波都同时 armed 了
fieldsip'. Measured this round by replaying each wave's own pinned tree
W27..W47 co-arm all three, as claimed -- but W24, W25 and W26 armed stayfield+stayfield2
with fieldsip ABSENT from the armed string, and at W24's tree (2d1024ee) the
`IsSoakCandidate('fieldsip')` gate did not exist in bots/ at all (0 sites; 1 site from
b51bac77 on). An unarmed fieldsip makes J.IsFieldSipEnough return true early, which is
byte-identically the behaviour a REJECTED fieldsip would ship -> those three waves did run
the configuration §ED.5 calls untested. So the constraint stands on the narrower, true
footing: 21 of the last 24 waves co-armed them, and the only three that did not are old,
bundle-wide (42-44 armed ids), and not known to carry a per-id condition-(a) reading for
RELEASE CONDITION (what would retire this row): a condition-(a) reading for stayfield /
stayfield2 taken on W24, W25 or W26 -- or on any future leg where fieldsip is unarmed.
If such a reading exists and is usable, this row is over-strict and should be dropped;
until someone looks, promoting the holding side alone ships an unmeasured configuration.
